design.pairing: A and B use the exact same sampled episodes and deal seeds; each receives its own deterministic action RNG stream initialized from the same master seed so pre-divergence stochastic decisions are coupled.

candidates.A: mean(raw eight-member Advantage vectors) then canonical lean regret matching
candidates.B: canonical lean regret matching independently per member then arithmetic mean of eight member policies

metrics: paired scenario-level SpinCore chips/exposure for A and B
all-opportunity target-action probability surfaces by candidate
deep-72o all-in probability and sampled-jam rates

gates.ev_noninferiority: B-minus-A paired 95% CI lower bound >= -0.50 chips per policy-seat-hand
gates.critical_absurdities: B must have zero PREFLOP_AA_FOLD and zero POSTFLOP_MONSTER_FOLD sampled flags
gates.high_card_no_draw: B ge80 ALL_IN fraction <= A ge80 fraction and <=0.0025 absolute
gates.deep_72o: B mean ALL_IN probability <= A +0.02 absolute
gates.trips_plus_fold: B mean Fold probability <= A +0.02 absolute

interpretation.pass: B is validated as the preferred aggregation operator for subsequent research/deployment gates; this still does not unblock long training because fallback/model-sign error remains unresolved.
interpretation.fail: Do not adopt B; aggregation candidate fails direct-play/common-chance validation.

prohibitions: no use of B as final solution to fallback pathology
